title: BLE characteristic value parser
description:
Decode standard BLE GATT characteristic formats to physical units.

**Scope:**
- Parse BLE characteristic value bytes according to GATT format descriptors
- Support common formats:
  - sint16 with 0.01 scale (temperature in 0.01 degrees C)
  - uint16 with 0.01 scale (humidity in 0.01 percent)
  - uint8 percentage (battery level)
  - sint16/uint16 with various scales (pressure, etc.)
  - IEEE-11073 FLOAT types
- Handle endianness (BLE uses little-endian)
- Return physical value with appropriate precision

**Format table (examples):**
| Characteristic | Format | Scale | Unit |
|----------------|--------|-------|------|
| 0x2A6E Temperature | sint16 | 0.01 | Cel |
| 0x2A6F Humidity | uint16 | 0.01 | %RH |
| 0x2A19 Battery Level | uint8 | 1 | % |
| 0x2A6D Pressure | uint32 | 0.1 | Pa |

**Output:** python/src/lichen/ble/gatt_value_parser.py
